s1.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
key_facts: man in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone
flare of symptoms with taper below 10 mg
previous treatments included hydroxychloroquine and adalimumab without improvement
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
skin biopsy showed nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining

raw.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
key_facts: man in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone
flare of symptoms with taper below 10 mg
previous treatments included hydroxychloroquine and adalimumab without improvement
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
skin biopsy showed nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining

differentials: STING-associated vasculopathy with onset in infancy
per_call: STING-associated vasculopathy with onset in infancy

shortlist.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: skin biopsy showed nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes, and low CD4 signal with robust CD8 signal on immunostaining

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: dermal papules on trunk and extremities, preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs, and relief of symptoms with daily oral prednisone

shortlist.label: Lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: inflammatory arthritis, skin lesions, and systemic symptoms

shortlist.label: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: similar clinical presentation to cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, with systemic symptoms and lymphadenopathy not always present

shortlist.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: inflammatory skin lesions, systemic symptoms, and potential for pulmonary involvement

raw.rationale: The presence of dermal papules with a preference for extensor surfaces, nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, and atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes on skin biopsy, along with clonal rearrangements in skin and bone marrow samples, strongly supports this diagnosis

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Lack of muscle weakness and specific dermatomyositis skin findings

rejected.label: Lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: No characteristic lupus autoantibodies or systemic features

rejected.label: Angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: Absence of systemic symptoms like fever, sweats, and lymphadenopathy

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid granulomatosis
rejected.why: No evidence of granulomatous inflammation or necrotizing lesions
